paras: Lerista nevinae, also known commonly as Nevin's three-toed slider and Nevin's slider, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Sphenomorphinae of the family Scincidae (skinks). The species is endemic to the Australian state of Western Australia.
The specific name, nevinae, is in honor of Anne F. Nevin of the Western Australian Museum.
Lerista nevinae has 18 scale rows at midbody.
Dorsally, it is pale brown, with black stripes. Ventrally, it is whitish. Adults have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 4 cm (1.6 in).
The preferred natural habitat of Lerista nevinae is shrubland on coastal dunes.
